name: Suraj Products Limited
about: Suraj Products Limited engages in the manufacture and sales of sponge iron by direct reduction of iron ore, pig iron, ingots and billet, TMT bars, and generation of power in India. It also provides quality control and support and maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Champion Cement Industries Limited and changed its name to Suraj Products Limited in 2000. Suraj Products Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Rajgangpur, India.
